**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Clause 7.6** contains the only MFN-style provision, and it runs *in our favour*: Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms. Under the playbook this is welcome and should be preserved.
- **Clause 12.3** further protects us: Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no "exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- Targeted searches (MFN/most-favoured, "favourable"/"favorable", benchmarking, competitor-pricing disclosure, exclusivity) across Fees (§7), Customer Responsibilities (§12) and General (§30) surfaced no obligation on us to extend Vendor our best terms or match third-party offers.

No walk-away risk present; nothing to change.
